<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX282024-10-1811-51-06" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon" part="I" next="exX282024-10-1811-51-05"> 
 <milestone n="Closing verses" unit="section"/><lg><l>'di na mkhas pa'i rnam gzhag ma mthong bar ||</l> 
 <l>shes bya'i gnas la mkhas par gang smra ba ||</l> 
 <l>des kyang bdag gi blo gros legs sbyangs pa'i ||</l> 
 <l>mkhas pa'i gzhung brgya'i ming yang thos re skan || </l></lg>
<lg> <l>shAkya'i bstan la shin tu mkhas rnams dang || </l>
 <l>rtsod ldan mkhas par rlom par 'dod pa rnams ||</l> 
 <l>bstan pa rgyan gyis dag par bya ba'i phyir ||</l>
 <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4006">dpal ldan rigs pa'i ral gri</rs>s bkod pa yin || </l></lg></seg></TEI>
